The current title and text are out-of-date and do not correspond to the current requirement. Following discussion, the intent is to reorient the section around existing 3.7.1: requirements here should mitigate the risk/impact of attacks where the attacker is able to abuse the user's session (either they have the session token, or they indirectly utilize it through CSRF and related attackes).

Proposal:

### V3.7 Defenses Against Session Abuse

This section provides requirements to mitigate the risk posed by hijacked or abused (such as through cross-site attacks) sessions.
